description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and the minimum FDE20 (inverted) for different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and ranges from 0.2 to 1.0, with a tick label interval of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE20 (←)" and ranges from 18 to 23, with a tick label interval of 1. The plot includes five lines representing different methods: Head Tuning (blue), FT (green), LoRA 16 (red), LoRA 64 (purple), and a grey shaded area. The Head Tuning line starts at a value of 23 and decreases to 21, then increases to 23 again. The FT line starts at 22, decreases to 20, and then increases to 22. The LoRA 16 line starts at 23, decreases to 21, and then increases to 23. The LoRA 64 line starts at 23, decreases to 20, and then increases to 22. The grey shaded area represents the range of values for the Head Tuning method.
